title: Group F-2 buildings.
officialText:
Notwithstanding the provisions of Sections 507.2 and 507.3, the area of a Group F-2 building of Type
IIA, IIIA or IV construction shall not be limited where the building is protected throughout with an approved automatic sprin kler
system in accordance with Section 903.3.1.1.
